newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent hits day high with U.S. gasoline strength.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent hits day high with U.S. gasoline strength.

text.p: IPE Brent crude and gas oil futures maintained early gains after New York's gasoline pit opened strongly again on Thursday.
Brent for September, expiring at the close of business, moved to a session highs of $19.18 a barrel while gas oil was up $3.50 a tonne at $173.50.
Dealers were watching the NYMEX unleaded gasoline contract to help underline IPE rises posted with the help of a slimmer North Sea Brent lifting programme for September.
September's Brent programme schedules three fewer 500,000 barrel cargoes than in August, pushing cash spreads wider.
